documentation.purpose: DataViews table over a single post type. The default view lists 20 rows, ordered by date descending, with title / status / author / date columns. The author can filter by status, search the title field, switch to a grid layout, paginate, and perform per-row or bulk row actions (edit, view, trash).

writes.purpose: Move selected posts to trash from the row action or bulk action.

states.renders: Rows rendered in the active layout (table or grid).

interactions.effect: Navigate to editor route for the post type.
Open the post's permalink in a new tab.
Confirm in a modal, then trash via deleteEntityRecord and DataViews refreshes the list.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews handles focus inside the grid; after trash modal closes focus returns to the action trigger.

constraints.note: Import from `@wordpress/dataviews/wp`, not the bare package path — bare risks React error #130.
Pass `context: 'edit'` so title.raw is populated; without it titles render as decoded HTML and edit flows silently break.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Table / grid view with built-in filtering, sorting, pagination, selection, and bulk actions.
Title cell renderer + modal action buttons.
Destructive primary action in the trash-confirm modal — WPDS 0.12 has no `tone="critical"`.
